title: Closed word classes: articles, pronouns, tense/aspect particles, modal and other dependent verbs, conjunctions, prepositions

fields.name: class
fields.description: Word class, as in the chapters of Morfologia (MOR2010)

fields.name: subclass
fields.description: The source's subcategory. article: definite, indefinite. pronoun: personal, possessive, reflexive, reciprocal, demonstrative, relative, interrogative, indefinite. particle (tense/aspect): simple, compound. verb (dependent verbs): modal, passive, copulative. conjunction: copulative, disjunctive, adversative (coordinating); conditional, final, causal, consecutive, temporal, concessive, completive (subordinating). preposition: simple, compound, expression.

fields.name: pap
fields.description: The Aruban form exactly as the source prints it. ... stands for the slot of a noun or a clause (e ... aki, ni ... ni).

fields.name: alt
fields.description: Other forms the source prints in the same place (cua/cual, ora (cu)), '; '-separated

fields.name: features
fields.description: Grammatical features from the source, '; '-separated: person and number (1sg ... 3pl, or sg, pl), emphatic, non-emphatic, after-preposition, adjectival, prepositional, independent, simple, compound, proximal, medial, distal, spanish, coordinating, subordinating, the tense and aspect values (past, present, future, perfective, imperfective, habitual, historic, atemporal) and the relations of a preposition (space, time, opposition, company, means, possession, material, quantity, manner, cause).

fields.name: en
fields.description: English gloss(es), '; '-separated; a short description in parentheses when no single word fits

fields.name: reviewed_by
fields.description: GitHub usernames of the reviewers, separated by '; '. Required when status is reviewed.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Printed page number(s), e.g. 38 or 38-39, roman for front matter.

$comment: Frictionless Table Schema plus x-papiamento extensions read by tools/validate.py. See _meta/conventions.md.
